application_receipt_retry.control_scope: optimistic cold ordinary + warm exact-hit lower bound; includes application links

ledger.traffic_scope: declared fixture payloads and stipulated controls only; not complete runtime traffic

evidence_class: bounded synthetic simulator; corrected installed-prefix control

logical_ownership.prefix_owner_scope: conservative synthetic shared-block/reference/path metadata and copy envelope; additional to decode/receipt/interpreter/runtime, not measured RSS
logical_ownership.scope: conservative fixture raw/HMAC/tuple-int/metadata and two snapshot envelope; excludes interpreter, application receipts, source/model/runtime and allocator/RSS

prefix_policy.admission: fixture assumes compiled prefix_f32 full-KV completed owner-free lineage with verification-none; real compiled admission not executed
prefix_policy.capture_cost_scope: prepare/immutable-copy/restore payloads and publications counted separately in both arms; upstream runtime.snapshot overlap, CPU and Python/native allocation unknown
prefix_policy.concurrent_control: wait for completed producer prefill/response under existing serial prepared queue; same reusable cuts, no additional bytes attributed to earlier publication
prefix_policy.public_boundary_disclosure: length and scheduling are public; all token/path matching remains caller-local
prefix_policy.retention: shared full blocks, clipped references, LRU eviction; full logits optional for proper prefixes
prefix_policy.selection: powers of two, every eight rows, total-1, budget-limited cut

real_geometry.ceiling_scope: unpruned u32 geometry only, NOT optimized serving traffic or a saving estimate
real_geometry.geometry_source: decode-cache-sdk-reference.md: 24 layers, 2 KV heads, dimension 64, vocabulary 151936

superseded_v1.observed_revision_start: on-disk v1 already routed corrections to inference and matched pre-v2 source hashes; earlier auditor snapshot not recovered
superseded_v1.status: rejected baseline; retained byte-identically, not a v2 replay target
superseded_v1.v1_source_reproduction: not asserted; original code bundle not archived

synthetic_topology.restart: synthetic index rebind; public artifact cache persists; no real process spawned

thresholds.branch: scheduled boundaries: incremental network ceiling zero; unscheduled gross <=7 causal rows per subsequent sibling if nearest scheduled cut survives; subtract candidate and explicit-control costs
thresholds.delta: network ceiling=0 locally; hit disk saving=(parent_rows*8) in fixture; metadata unchanged
thresholds.first_unique_request: zero incremental network gain established, including scheduled-boundary sibling batch; cold setup always charged
thresholds.receipt: retry_probability > publication_cost/(avoided_retry_cost - lookup_cost), if denominator positive; compare optimized full-hit decode, not replay

unknown: net benefit of unscheduled boundary selection
actual runtime controls/framing including inference->preparation acknowledgements
